name: Ishihara Shizuka
source:
Shizuka is Akane's best friend and the only one who knows their secret that they're married. She's in love with Takuya whom she calls 'onii-chan'. Although she loves Akane very much she's desperate for Takuya's love, enough that she offers Akane what she thinks is terrible relationship advice in hopes that they split up.

[spoiler]Desperate for Takuya's embrace she finally sneaks into their bed when Akane is away and tricks him into thinking she's Akane.[/spoiler]
